newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products fall on slack demand, lower crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products fall on slack demand, lower crude.

text.p: NWE oil products fell on Monday with naphtha and gas oil lowered by weak demand.
Naphtha was easy with slack end-user demand leaving prices tracking Iraqi oil sale led weakness in crude.
Gasoline eased with crude, but news of one-day strikes set for Tuesday at three French refineries limited losses.
Fuel oil barges fell sharply, shedding $3 a tonne, essentially on crude. Cargoes were also softer, but not to the same degree.
Gas oil fell $8.50 a tonne on futures. Low sulphur diesel cargo premiums slipped around $1 on thin end-user demand.
